title: Active Exploitation of Microsoft SharePoint JWT Token Bypass Vulnerability
description:
On July 14, 2026, CVE-2026-55040 was disclosed, revealing a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint's JWT token validation process. The flaw allows remote unauthenticated attackers to forge valid JWTs, impersonating SharePoint users and potentially gaining administrative access. Following the release of a public proof-of-concept exploit on July 28, attacks against exposed SharePoint servers have surged, as confirmed by threat intelligence firm Defused. Organizations are urged to prioritize patching affected SharePoint servers and review logs for unusual activity. The vulnerability affects SharePoint Server Subscription Edition version 16.0.19725.20210 and is considered a high-priority security issue.

Key Points:
• CVE-2026-55040 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass SharePoint authentication.
• Public exploit code has led to active attacks against vulnerable SharePoint servers.
• Organizations must patch affected systems and monitor for unauthorized access.
